context.heading: Why it mattered
lead: The compact instruction circulates as a summary of Hamilton’s national perspective, while the quotation reference explicitly calls it a paraphrase. Later European and transatlantic speakers reused it for their own arguments about cooperation across borders; those uses do not recover Hamilton’s original wording.
